title: Black Bob "4 B's" keychain
subtitle: Concept C2d: a big tilted, cropped BB framed by the four B's · 56 mm square · red, white, black · shown hanging · millimetres

dims.label: Front B + frame + black line top

scale_note: Real size: 56 mm square (the concept sketch's size), 63 mm tall with the tab. Type 60 in the real-size box to preview the first keychain's size.
notes: v4: the black line is now only 0.4 mm deep (2 layers, red below it), down from 0.8. It looks the same from the top and sides, since black is opaque at 0.4, but only 2 layers now mix red, white and black instead of 4. That's about 4 fewer AMS colour swaps per plate (~15, was ~17). Everything else is as in v3: Be safe on top, Be kind right, Be helpful left, Be the best you on the bottom (upright). The front B is flush with the line (3.4 mm), the back B is 2.8 mm, and the frame text is 3.8 mm. To cut waste further, fill the plate: copies share the swaps.
